description: The Bybit cold wallet as Safe's own public words described it before 21 February 2025. The wallet is a Safe v1.1.1 proxy whose slot 0 held the v1.1.1 singleton. Every invariant below was read from the contract sources at commit 892448e93f6203b530630f20de45d8a55fde7463 of safe-global/safe-smart-account, the v1.1.1 tag, dated 2019-12-13. Nothing dated after the fork block was read. spec/SOURCES.md names the line each one came from. Writer shape: RealDeal/notebook/8-integration/book/04-spec-scope-and-quality.md.

target.name: Bybit cold wallet 1 (Safe v1.1.1 proxy over the v1.1.1 singleton)

invariants.statement: every call other than masterCopy() is delegatecalled to the address held in storage slot 0, and its return data or revert is passed back unchanged
execTransaction reverts unless the first threshold signatures each recover to an owner over the hash of this transaction and the current nonce, in strictly ascending owner order
each execTransaction that passes the signature check increments the nonce before it executes, so one set of signatures executes at most once
operation 0 calls the destination; operation 1 runs the destination's code against the wallet's own storage, so that code can write any slot the wallet has, slot 0 included
the master copy changes only through a Safe transaction: changeMasterCopy may be called by the wallet itself and by no one else
owners and the threshold change only through a Safe transaction, and the threshold can never exceed the owner count or fall to zero
